question: During the 2025 demonstration, which types of drones were successfully destroyed by DRDO’s DEW Mk-II(A)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fixed-wing UAVs and Swarm drones**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) successfully demonstrated the **Directed Energy Weapon (DEW) Mk-II(A)** during trials in 2025.
 
• The DEW Mk-II(A) effectively neutralized **Fixed-wing Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) and Swarm drones**, showcasing its operational capabilities against advanced aerial threats.
 
• The system employs **laser-based technology** to disable or destroy aerial targets by disrupting their onboard electronics or structure.
 
• These trials highlighted India’s advancements in **non-kinetic warfare technologies**, positioning DRDO among the global leaders in Directed Energy Weapons development.
 
• The DEW Mk-II(A) was specifically designed to counter **emerging threats from drones**, which are increasingly being used in military and surveillance applications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Directed Energy Weapons (DEWs):**

 
 
• DEWs are a class of weapons that emit energy in a focused direction to damage or disable targets.
 
• Common types of DEWs include **laser weapons, microwave weapons, and particle beam weapons**.
 
• They offer advantages such as precision targeting, minimal collateral damage, and low operational costs once deployed.
 
 
 
• **Fixed-wing UAVs:**
 
 
• Fixed-wing UAVs are unmanned aerial systems that use wings like traditional airplanes for flight.
 
• They are commonly used for **surveillance, reconnaissance, and delivery applications** due to their long flight range and efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Swarm Drones:**
 
 
• Swarm drones refer to a coordinated group of drones that operate together to achieve a common objective.
 
• These are often used for **military operations, search-and-rescue missions, and surveillance**.
 
• Swarm drones leverage **artificial intelligence and communication systems** to coordinate their movements.
 
 
 
• **India’s DEW Program:**
 
 
• India has been developing Directed Energy Weapons under DRDO’s Advanced Weapons and Technology program.
 
• These systems are part of the country’s effort to counter modern threats like drones, missiles, and other aerial platforms.
 
 
 
• **Global DEW Development:**
 
 
• Countries such as the USA, China, and Russia are actively developing DEWs for military applications.
 
• These weapons are considered **critical for next-generation warfare** due to their ability to neutralize high-speed and agile threats.
